typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, monospace

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs
header.logo: Evolv Regression Hub (Indigo-600 badge icon + bold font)

sub_header.classes: bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-600
features: Active DB: Oracle PROD-COPY / Baseline V4.2

layout_architecture.grid_density: High Density, compact 28px-36px table row heights, tabular numbers, sticky header tables, clear cell diff indicators

key_modules_and_components.description: High-level summary of recent regression runs, pass rates, failure trends, flaky tests, and quick actions.
components: KPI Cards: Total Runs, Pass Rate %, Avg Duration, Unresolved Failure Points, Flaky Count
Pass/Fail Trend Chart (Recharts stacked bar / area chart with clean light theme colors)
Recent Execution Activity Stream with direct link to Failure Explorer
Quick Action Bar: Launch New Run, Compare Builds, View Impacted Tests

key_modules_and_components.description: Replaces Excel Test Driver & TeamCity job triggers. Configure steps, SQL data queries ('r' sheet equivalent), input zip files, and target branch/release.
components: Build / Branch / Release Selector (e.g. main, release/2026.3, feature/DB-sync)
Build Folder & Step Sequence Configurator (Drag & Drop or Ordered List)
SQL Query & Data Loader Modal/Drawer for Oracle DB fetching per test point
Impacted-Tests Only switch (uses git diff analysis)
Zip Input Uploader with file validation preview

key_modules_and_components.description: Real-time or simulated execution step log, progress bars, SQL query status, row counts, pass/fail live badges.
components: Live Progress Bar (overall percentage, time elapsed, estimated remaining)
Step Execution Tree (Status per 'r' sheet SQL query compare)
Live Console Stream & Oracle DB Query Latency indicator

key_modules_and_components.description: The core comparison workspace replacing Excel sheets starting with 'r'. Shows side-by-side SQL query results (Expected Baseline vs Actual DB Result).
components: Failure Tree Nav: Filter by Sheet Name, SQL Query, Status, or Failure Reason
Side-by-Side SQL Data Grid with exact cell diff highlighting (Green = Added/Expected, Red = Actual Discrepancy, Amber = Type Mismatch)
One-Click Accept Baseline Toolbar: Buttons for 'Promote Cell to Baseline', 'Promote Row to Baseline', 'Promote Entire Test Point', 'Promote Entire Run Baseline'
AI Failure Explanation Drawer: Analyzes error message, schema change, or query mismatch and suggests root cause
Flaky & Failure History Timeline Modal

key_modules_and_components.module_name: Build A vs Build B Direct Comparison
key_modules_and_components.description: Compares execution results between Branch A and Branch B directly without needing an existing baseline.
components: Dual Selector Header: Select Build A (e.g. release-4.1) vs Build B (e.g. release-4.2)
Diff Overview Summary Cards: Matches count, Discrepancies count, Missing rows count
Split SQL Table View with synced scrolling

key_modules_and_components.description: Searchable registry of test points, SQL queries, sheet associations ('r' prefix), tags, ownership, and flakiness metrics.
components: Search & Tag Filter Bar (Filter by module, database table, author, risk tier)
Test Point Detail Drawer with SQL Query Editor, execution history graph, and sample expected dataset
Batch Tagging and Export Actions

key_modules_and_components.description: Audit trail of all 1-click baseline updates with author, timestamp, reason, and 1-click restore/rollback option.
components: Timeline of Baseline Commits
Diff view of baseline updates (Old Baseline vs Updated Baseline)
Rollback Baseline Confirmation Dialog

key_modules_and_components.description: Generates downloadable executive sign-off reports in PDF format (print view modal with clean layout) and Excel workbook export.
components: Export Options Modal: Choose format (PDF Executive Summary, Detailed Excel Workbook), include AI Failure Summaries, Sign-off signature block
Sign-Off Approval Banner for Release Readiness

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 with subtle rounded-lg or rounded-md edges
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-xs or shadow-sm for subtle elevation; no deep dark glow
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped or rounded-md status badges with matching border and light background (e.g., bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200)
visual_enhancers.code_diff: Side-by-side or inline code view with font-mono text-xs, line numbers, and light green/red background highlights

instructions_to_main_agent.theme_enforcement: STRICTLY LIGHT THEME. Background must be slate-50 or white. Text must be slate-900 or slate-700. Never use full dark background layouts.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_file_extension: All custom React component files in src/ must use .js or .jsx extension (e.g., src/components/FailureExplorer.js). Do NOT create .tsx files.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_components: Use existing components in src/components/ui/ (table, dialog, sheet, tabs, badge, button, dropdown-menu, select, card, sonner) with light theme styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_ids: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, and modals MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='run-suite-button', data-testid='accept-baseline-cell-btn', data-testid='build-compare-select-a').
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_data: Provide rich realistic mock data for Oracle DB queries, Excel sheet 'r' comparisons, branch diffs, failure reasons, and baseline history so the dashboard feels 100% complete and alive.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, avoid AI slop by building clean, high-density, professional enterprise tools.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and clean border-slate-200 lines.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on sticky headers and light overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep standard human left-to-right reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or crisp rectangular buttons with clean hover states.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use generous padding inside card containers and tables to avoid text collision.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
